verdicts.reason: A keeps the vertical stack and a clear headline-to-CTA hierarchy, but the top-right circle is squashed into an ellipse, the can is small, and the tiny legal line is jammed between the button and the bottom edge. B lets the big teal circle cut behind the can and the headline, which looks like a collision. Its oversized CTA pill crowds the headline, the can is shrunk to a tiny, unreadable label, and the legal text wraps to leave 'details.' orphaned on its own line.
